envelope.description: Give the planner loop its own attempt limit

body.title: Give the planner loop its own attempt limit
body.summary: First search the planner and orchestrator tests for PlanBuilderExhausted, attempts.length and structuredOutputRetries assumptions. Then add a named constant of 5 in the planner and use it for the correction loop only; keep cfg.shaper.structuredOutputRetries as the wire-level maxAttempts given to completeStructured and for every other user. Update only the tests that follow from the new limit.
acceptanceChecks: the tests that assumed three attempts are listed and each is updated or left with a stated reason
a script valid only on the fifth reply is accepted on the fifth call
a script that never passes throws PlanBuilderExhausted with five primary failures after exactly five calls
every completeStructured call receives the shared structuredOutputRetries value as maxAttempts

tests.name: src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: five-call acceptance and exhaustion with the planner limit
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: completeStructured receives the shared maxAttempts, not the planner limit
